full_page.content:
Page 87
Aug. 4 Mrs. Virginia Gee - non Cath. - 20 - operated on ten days ago - full of cancer - a number of her organs removed and given sixty days to live. Enrolled by kind neighbor last Saturday (July 31) Drs. astonished to see her go home yesterday ....... August 20 here To-night all smiling enrolls perpetually.
5th at 9:15 P.M. - A Novice phoned from Mercy novitiate ... her little brother Wm. in Oak Park (Chicago) has infantile paralysis. .... Enrolled % phone.
6 Neil J. Mackinnon - 9 (Tomorrow) - blind in left Eye since May 30th That day when playing. .. fell and had his eye pierced ...... Remarkable .... his older brother now almost 19 .. playing foot ball two years ago lost his sight from a stroke in the left eye and for a month it was hopeless - according to specialists. He is now in service since last March and has a number medals for expert marksmanship - his sight perfect. . Deo Gr.
Page 88 Aug. 6 Roman Sumanski - 22 - fits in sleep that make him very nervous and weak afterward ...
9 Thanks - John Datson - 11 - pronounced spinal-maningitis by two Drs. Aunt phoned enrollment when he was showing every indication of dreaded disease; was home before week was over. Drs. say there are still indications he had it. 13th was here in Monastery this Evening O.K.
Thanks - C. Howard Menear - 53 - had lost one kidney and the other had been refusing to function. He was dying to all appearance when he asked to be baptized - it was in Carmel Mercy Hospital. Wife had for years been going to Catholic services. Now both are regu- lar communicants. When he got well - Drs said it would be a year before he could go back to work - went back 9 months before sche- dule
Helen White - 33 - Apendix and Gall-stones - has four small chil- dren ......
.. Clara Butler - 37 - Eye trouble - has three small children . .
Page 89 Aug. 11 Baby Constance Polcyn - 2'2 - spinal maningitis when a year old; deaf ever since.
